runner: run_nora_libero.py: the loop of nora experiments/libero/run_libero_eval_nora.py, with OpenVLA's experiments/robot LIBERO utilities (the libero_utils/robot_utils it imports are empty in the NORA repository)
env_seed: env.seed(0) in get_libero_env; global seed 7 set once
max_steps: episode_lengths per suite if set, else --env.episode_length in the extra flags if set, else LeRobot defaults (spatial 280, object 280, goal 300, libero_10 520)
note: Official NORA LIBERO script settings: per-suite fine-tuned checkpoint, Qwen2.5-VL-3B with FAST tokens and greedy decoding, the per-suite LIBERO normalization stats written in nora_utils.py, OpenVLA image processing (180 deg flip, resize 224), 256 px env images, 10 no-op steps, at most 500 policy queries for every suite, gripper normalized+inverted and snapped to +1 when >= 0, seed 7. The script is written for the NORA-Long checkpoints (time_horizon 5); these single-step checkpoints keep the Nora class default time_horizon 1. Env envs/nora (venv on roboelo-libero: transformers 4.50.0, accelerate 1.5.2 as in nora/inference/requirements.txt; torch 2.7.1+cu128 instead of 2.4.0; MuJoCo 3.3.2). An exception is recorded and the rollout re-run (the official loop ends the episode as a failure).
policy_settings: as stored in the checkpoint (policy_config.json) unless overridden by the extra flags
